# fw-unified-stack crate

> Descriptor types and a catalogue of the Rust stacks fw tracks (Burn, Rig, rmcp, ACP, a2a-rs, Pingora, Quiche, Yazi, Kitty protocols, Hex), plus Kitty and OSC…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-unified-stack/

Descriptor types and a catalogue of the Rust stacks fw tracks (Burn, Rig, rmcp, ACP, a2a-rs, Pingora, Quiche, Yazi, Kitty protocols, Hex), plus Kitty and OSC 133 encoders; none of those stacks is a dependency
